title: 선주상호보험조합법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 2 (Attachment of Minutes)
Where a shipowners' mutual insurance association (hereinafter referred to as the "Association") applies for authorization, permission, or approval under the Shipowners' Mutual Insurance Association Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Act") or under the Insurance Business Act as applied mutatis mutandis pursuant to the Act, and any matter covered by the application requires a resolution of the Association's general meeting or board of directors, the minutes of the relevant meeting shall be attached to the application.
